card.name: Adverbs ending a verb phrase
card.fires_on: An adverb or adverb ending that closes a verb phrase, such as more, a lot, publicly, medically, early, or an -ally/-lessly ending. A comma, period, or 'than' often comes next.

modes.label: Comparative 'more'
modes.description: The word 'more' right after a verb and its object, before 'than'.
modes.example: Kamrul loves his children<< more>> than his own life.

modes.label: Manner adverbs
modes.description: An adverb ending such as -ally, -ly, or -lessly that finishes a verb phrase.

modes.label: Other adverbs
modes.description: Short adverbs such as 'a lot' or 'early' that finish a clause.
modes.example: You will see that I follow #7 a<< lot>>.)

card.writes: It promotes commas, periods and semicolons, so it pushes toward ending the clause with punctuation after the adverb.
card.plain: It fires on an adverb that completes a verb phrase, where punctuation or 'than' usually comes next.
